sentiment: Care is quiet magic — it turns small ordinary things into little worlds worth keeping.
scene: A tiny candle-lit workshop cluttered with half-built miniature rooms, dust motes drifting through a single window of late amber light.

stories.title: “I just chose words carefully”
stories.reason: Restraint in language as an act of care — every word a small, deliberate world.
stories.summary: Choosing words with care is a quiet discipline. Restraint isn't emptiness — it's what gives language its weight.

stories.title: My hobby of building miniatures and taking pretty pictures
stories.reason: Tiny handmade rooms — the plain joy of tending miniature worlds by hand.
stories.summary: A hobby of building dollhouse-scale rooms and photographing them — proof that small, careful worlds hold real light.

stories.title: Highlighting My Code Based on How Much I Care
stories.reason: Attention as a lens — what we care about glows brighter than the rest.
stories.summary: Highlighting code by how much you care admits what most tools hide: attention is the scarcest resource, and we spend it on what matters.
